greeter.title: Welcome!
greeter.body: I'm Weave. I'm here to help you get stuff done.

steps.title: Your canvas, your home
steps.body: Pin what matters, find it fast. Home is where you keep the stuff you don't want to dig for — pin a chat or an agent.

steps.title: All your engines in one place
steps.body: Whichever coding engine you use — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and more — you can chat with it here, and switch anytime.

steps.title: Ask Weave anything
steps.body: Start a chat, describe what you want, and watch Weave read and edit files in your project directly.

steps.title: Agents have joined the chat
steps.body: An agent is a specialist you talk to directly. @mention one in a chat and it works with you like a teammate, not a tool.

steps.title: Point Weave at a file
steps.body: Type @ in the composer to mention a specific file, so Weave knows exactly what you mean without you spelling it out.

taskDetails.connectEngine: Pick which coding engine powers your chats — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and more, in Settings.
taskDetails.startChat: Send your first message and watch Weave work in your project.
taskDetails.createProject: Point Weave at a folder on disk. It reads and edits files inside it.
taskDetails.addWidget: Pin a clock, note, or agent onto your Home canvas.
